gauge_fixed_identity: 2*r*E_g + b'*E_b + f'*E_f + h'*E_h + w'*E_w + 2*d(f*E_f)/dr = 0, after g=r^2

reduction_contract.permitted_solver_reduction: Use the identity to select an independent equation subset only after specifying a nonsingular pivot; always evaluate E_g as a separate constraint residual.
reduction_contract.forbidden: Do not omit E_g from candidate qualification or infer it from small residuals without bounding the identity defect.
reduction_contract.angular_term: W1'*E_w^(1) must be retained off shell; it vanishes only when the exact first-order angular equation is satisfied.

claim_ceiling: This verifies the radial-diffeomorphism identity of the published reduced one-dimensional action. It does not solve the finite-alpha spin-squared BVP, certify a numerical solution, prove existence, or qualify a nonlinear branch.
